feedback: Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is stated for it. The candidate is iteration 6's controller (base_speed 0.9, kp 1.4, ki 0, kd 0.5, line_loss last_direction, weights [-2,-1,0,1,2]) with sensor y held at 0.07 and only the outer sensors widened from x = ±0.032 to ±0.040 m. Geometry is valid: x is within ±0.08, the footprint is 16 mm, and there are five sensors matching five weights. Iteration 6 is the best raced design (683.7). Its slalom went off_track in all 20 runs at progress 0.392, while its oval and s-bend both finished 20/20. Iteration 9 (kd 0.6) lowered slalom progress to 0.351, and iterations 7 and 8 (base_speed 0.85; y 0.075) also lowered it. Lateral reach is the lever not yet tested on the slalom. The off-track limit is max(0.06, 0.0125 + 0.12/4) = 0.06 m, so body width cannot help. The change is a single-variable step from the best design, so any shift in results is attributable to sensor span. Approve it: it is valid, it tests the one remaining lever, and only one iteration follows this one, so race telemetry is worth more than another review round. Read the race as follows. If s-bend finishes fall below 18 of 20, or s-bend steering_oscillation exceeds about 0.35, the outer sensors are reacting to the tape on curves too early, so return x to ±0.032 m and keep iteration 6's settings for the final iteration. If slalom progress rises above about 0.40 while the oval and s-bend stay at 20/20, keep ±0.040 m for the final iteration. If slalom progress stays near 0.39 with no change, the slalom geometry is the limit, and the final iteration should lock iteration 6's settings.
requested_changes: Keep base_speed 0.9, kp 1.4, ki 0, kd 0.5, y 0.07 and line_loss last_direction as in iteration 6. Widen the outer sensors from x ±0.032 to ±0.040 m, because iteration 6 is the best design (683.7) and its slalom progress (0.392) is the only lever left untested.

If the s-bend finishes fall below 18 of 20, or s-bend steering_oscillation exceeds about 0.35, return x to ±0.032 m. Iteration 5 (y 0.07, x ±0.032) held s-bend finishes at 19 of 20, and iteration 9 (kd 0.6) showed that extra turn gain costs the slalom.

If slalom progress rises above about 0.40 with the oval at 20/20 and the s-bend at 18/20 or better, keep x ±0.040 m for the final iteration. If slalom progress stays at about 0.39 or below, lock iteration 6's settings (x ±0.032 m) for the final iteration, since no tested lever has moved the slalom past 0.39.
